actions.reason: Settlement population changed autonomously with Oscar settling; I still have a concrete 57-gold-to-80-gold gap for home ownership, so I will test whether forest wood is both a useful resource and a sale path.

Repeated chopping gave two wood and four gold per action, advanced woodcutting skill and raised character level while costing noticeable stamina. Six wood is now enough to test a sale and close the last 11-gold gap to the home price, so I am returning to the village shop instead of repeating the loop.

The shop explicitly values wood at 4 gold each, but this driver's generic action closes the dialog before selecting a sale button; I am preserving that harness limitation and switching to the mine, whose adventure flow the driver can operate through normal UI controls.

The mine is accessible as a production resource site with 100 units remaining, each extraction costing 10 stamina and awarding materials plus 4 gold; I have not found an entry to a dungeon here, so I will explore the fog route to see whether it leads to a distinct adventure goal.

Fog exploration revealed the mine and the UI now explicitly offers a three-part sequence: normal monster, elite, guard boss. I am trying the first floor with current HP 103 and two potions, then I will reassess before deeper stages.
